newsitem.title: USA: Gadzooks sees Q2 EPS cut, to cut prices.
newsitem.headline: Gadzooks sees Q2 EPS cut, to cut prices.

text.p: Gadzooks Inc said Thursday that the anticipated impact of lower sales and gross margins and a potential inventory write-down reserve will reduce second quarter earnings to about $0.01 to $0.03 per share.
The company previously announced that it expected net earnings for the second quarter to range from $0.12 to $0.18 per share, compared with $0.18 per share for the second quarter 1996.
The company said it has implemented additional price cuts to accelerate sales of remaining early summer merchandise in its stores before the back-to-school season.

"After determining that sales volume for clearance items in our stores was not high enough during the Fourth of July holiday promotion period, we instituted more aggressive price reductions for the remainder of the second quarter," the company said.
It also said it will write down any unsold clearance merchandise at the end of the quarter.

The company reiterated that it does not expect disappointing second-quarter performance to impact ongoing store operations or its plans to have 250 stores open before the beginning of the 1997 Christmas season.
